meta.title: perf: optimize cache and token handling
meta.body_summary: Introduce performance optimizations: skip unnecessary cache clearing, environment-aware token counting, debug metadata, and assertion type handling; claims gradual memory leak and cache invalidation under high load are addressed.

perf_labels.notes: Devin PR with narrative perf claims; no human review, closed 5 min after creation; gru-agent bot reported unit test writing failures.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 46 changed lines across 3 files, this is a very small edit. As a small-step performance PR it was closed without merge, indicating maintainer rejection rather than scale concerns.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review comments; PR was closed immediately after creation. Gru-agent bot reported unit test writing failures for all changed files, but no human feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve cache performance, token counting, and assertion handling.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed silently by maintainer typpo within 5 minutes of creation, with no comment; only bot activity (Devin intro, gru-agent test failure).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent-authored PR with narrative perf claims was closed immediately by maintainer without review; suggests process-related rejection (maybe not requested or outside agent scope) rather than technical failure.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics; only narrative claims.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without any iterative fix cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Modified src/evaluator.ts (27 lines) for token counting and debug metadata; src/cache.ts (12 lines) to skip unnecessary cache clearing; src/assertions/index.ts (7 lines) for assertion type handling.

PR closed by maintainer without additional activity after 5 minutes.
